description: This PHP class 'Project' under namespace 'Goteo\Model\Call' manages projects in the context of calls or campaigns, providing methods to retrieve, validate, save, and manipulate project data related to calls and their configurations. It includes functions to get projects assigned to calls, check project status, set dropability based on call configuration, and perform various statistical operations.

classes.name: Project
classes.description: Manages project data within a call context, offering methods for project retrieval, validation, saving, and statistical analysis.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Fetches projects associated with a specific call, applying filters for status and category. Returns detailed project objects including investment data.

methods.name: getMini
methods.description: Retrieves a simplified list of projects associated with a call, with minimal details such as id, name, status, amount, and investments.

methods.name: getAvailable
methods.description: Returns projects that are available for inclusion in a call, considering category, icon, and status filters.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the project instance ensuring required fields are present before saving.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the current project instance, associating it with a call.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the association of a project from a call.

methods.name: calledMini
methods.description: Fetches minimal details about the call associated with a given project.

methods.name: setDropable
methods.description: Determines whether a project is eligible for funding (dropable) based on call configuration and project status.

methods.name: getMaxdrop
methods.description: Calculates the maximum amount that can be allocated or invested in a project within the call's constraints.

methods.name: is_assigned
methods.description: Checks if a project is assigned to any call owned by a specific user.

methods.name: numProjects
methods.description: Counts the number of projects associated with a call.

methods.name: numRunningProjects
methods.description: Counts projects currently in campaign status for a call.

methods.name: numSuccessProjects
methods.description: Counts projects that have successfully met funding goals within a call.

methods.name: addOneApplied
methods.description: Increments the count of projects that have applied in a call.

methods.name: genderStats
methods.description: Returns percentage distribution of male and female investors among the provided projects.
